sources.title: Get started with Gemma models - Google AI for Developers
sources.snippet: Select a model, tune it for a specific task, and then deploy it in an application, or share it with the community. This guide helps you get started with picking a model, testing its capabilities, and optionally, tuning the model you selected for your application.

sources.snippet: This model card summarizes details on the models' architecture, capabilities, limitations, and evaluation processes. sources.title: GitHub - google-deepmind/gemma: Gemma open-weight LLM library, from ...
sources.snippet: Gemma is a family of open-weights Large Language Model (LLM) by Google DeepMind, based on Gemini research and technology. This repository contains the implementation of the gemma PyPI package. A JAX library to use and fine-tune Gemma. For examples and use cases, see our documentation. Please report issues and feedback in our GitHub.
